isogenic_exception.statement: ADR 0066 Isogenic exception: the declared in-vitro hiPSC-CM models carry a disease genotype with an isogenic control and are kept as their own evidence type inside this category even though a human CM-pseudobulk cohort (Reichart-CM) exists for the same category: a mixed-etiology clinical cohort and a single-genotype isogenic model answer different questions, and collapsing them loses the causal signature. The category therefore has one tier-1 human CM-pseudobulk pair (Reichart genotype-positive DCM + ARVC) and tier-2 isogenic bulk datasets; `tier` records the winning tier and each dataset record carries its own `evidence_type` and `tier`.

tiering.rule: Collect all qualifying declared sources in ascending tier order; measure the complete cumulative disease DEG union on the frozen axis (axis-resolved, not genome-wide) after each tier.
